# Lab 13.10: Create a Perimeter in Dry-run Mode

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a VPC Service Controls perimeter around a project in dry-run mode, and find the violations it would cause without blocking anything.

## Steps

1. **Get your access policy ID and project number.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud access-context-manager policies list --organization=ORG_ID
export POLICY_ID=YOUR_POLICY_ID
export PROJECT_NUMBER=$(gcloud projects describe $PROJECT_ID --format="value(projectNumber)")</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create a bucket to protect.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets create gs://$PROJECT_ID-vpcsc --location=us-central1
echo "protected" | gcloud storage cp - gs://$PROJECT_ID-vpcsc/data.txt</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Create the perimeter in dry-run mode.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud access-context-manager perimeters dry-run create lab_perimeter \
  --perimeter-title="Lab perimeter" \
  --perimeter-type=regular \
  --perimeter-resources=projects/$PROJECT_NUMBER \
  --perimeter-restricted-services=storage.googleapis.com \
  --policy=$POLICY_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Access the bucket from outside.** Cloud Shell is outside the perimeter.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage cat gs://$PROJECT_ID-vpcsc/data.txt</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   It still works, because dry-run does not block.

5. **Find the dry-run violation.** In **Logs Explorer**, run:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • TEXT
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">protoPayload.metadata.@type="type.googleapis.com/google.cloud.audit.VpcServiceControlAuditMetadata"
protoPayload.metadata.dryRun=true</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The entry shows the violation reason, for example `NO_MATCHING_ACCESS_LEVEL`.

6. **See it in the console.** Go to **Security → VPC Service Controls**. The perimeter shows a **Dry run** configuration and no enforced configuration.

7. **Keep the perimeter** for the next lab.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Access from Cloud Shell | Allowed in dry-run |
| Violation | Logged with `dryRun: true` |
| Purpose | Find what would break before enforcing |
| Restricted service | Cloud Storage |
